title: Notice inviting application, Under the West Bengal Scheme for Providing Government Employment (Group D Post) to one Eligible Family Member of the Victims killed in Political Violence, 2026 Government of West Bengal Home and Hill Affairs Dep
text:
KEY LINES:
No. 3577-PL/PA/2P-53/2026 Date 13.11.2026

the incident occurred, from 17.11. 2026 to 7.12.2026

FULL TEXT:
Government of West Bengal
Home and Hill Affairs Department
Nabanna, Howrah
No. 3577-PL/PA/2P-53/2026 Date 13.11.2026
NOTICE INVITING APPLICATIONS
Under the West Bengal Scheme for Providing Government Employment (Group D
Post) to one Eligible Family Member of the Victims killed in Political Violence, 2026
Vide Notification vide No. 3405-PL/PA/2P-53/2026, Dtd. 30/10/2026
 Applications in Form-A can be made to the District Magistrate of the district where
the incident occurred, from 17.11. 2026 to 7.12.2026
 Application forms are also available at the concerned DM office
 For Scheme details & Forms please visit: https://home.wb.gov.in/
Sd/-
Principal Secretary
Home and Hill Affairs Department
